verdict.rationale: Polar documents automatic dunning: failed charges move subscriptions to past_due, trigger a fixed retry schedule (2,5,7,7 days up to 21 days), and send recovery emails with a Customer Portal link to update payment methods. This directly matches the story's core ask of automatic retries with dunning and recovery emails. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of email deliverability or customization of dunning templates, and no detail on configurable retry schedules or A/B tested recovery flows.
